confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from mixed-date sources: Zurich, Geneva and Basel price levels, Interlaken guide figures, and Swiss menus. Beer and wine are based on Interlaken and Zurich menu and guide prices, and cocktail and coffee on Zurich and Swiss survey figures. All CHF figures were converted at an assumed CHF 1 = USD 1.25, which was not sourced. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live booking pages. The FX observation was not read from rba.gov.au. It comes from a third-party RBA data mirror dated 2026-07-31, so it is about 11 weeks older than the generation date and is not the latest RBA observation. The source_url is the official RBA exchange-rates page, given as the location to verify, not a page I read. Verify the FX rate against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Interlaken is a Swiss summer resort town. Restaurant and drink anchors use Zurich, Geneva and Basel price levels and Interlaken-area menus, adjusted down slightly for a smaller town. Hotel and hostel anchors reflect July resort demand in the Jungfrau region.
